title: bzf received files
description: The store's own document `received.json`: the files received into the project's folders (plans, photos, documents), each by its hash, oldest first. The bytes are kept as an object by the hash, so a file replaced or deleted in its folder is noticed and can be restored. A name received again in place has a newer entry after the older.

name.description: Its name in its folder, NFC-normalised, unique in the folder regardless of case.

folder.description: The folder it was received into: `Zeichnungen` (plans: DWG, DXF, PDF, IFC), `Fotos`, `Dokumente` (everything else).

role.description: What its folder is for, the same in every language: `plans` (`Zeichnungen`), `photos` (`Fotos`), `documents` (`Dokumente`). The folder names are fixed identifiers of the format and are not translated (README, "How the documents are written"); a reader derives `role` from `folder` where it is absent.

sha256.description: The hash of its bytes, its identity.

type.description: What kind of document it is, so a logbook can find it (the CEN template's documentation category): a plan, a photo, a scene (LoD2) or orthophoto, a bill, a data sheet, an EPD, a manual, a certificate (an earlier Energieausweis), an inspection report, a permit, a contract.

from.description: From whom it came: an architect's office, the owner, a data service.

licence.description: The licence it came under, where it has one (LoD2 and orthophotos: per Land, dl-de/zero-2.0, dl-de/by-2.0, CC BY 4.0). A writer keeps it, and an issue or export that contains the file or anything derived from it carries its attribution.

id.description: The licence's id: an SPDX id or the licence's own short name.

attribution.description: The attribution its licence asks for: "© GeoBasis-DE / LGLN 2026".

mayPassOn.description: False where it may not be passed to others (an architect's plans under copyright, a photo of people): an issue asks before including it.

about.description: The items it shows or documents: the photo of a boiler, the data sheet of a window.
